Preprocessing pipelines and data leakage

scikit-learn 1.9.1

Combine preprocessing and prediction so that each learned step sees only training data.

Keep the test set out of fitting

Leakage means information unavailable at prediction time affects training or evaluation. Split before fitting scalers, imputers, or feature selectors. A Pipeline fits transforms on training data and reuses those fitted transforms on test rows.

from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

model = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), LinearRegression())
model.fit([[2], [4], [6]], [5, 9, 13])
print(round(float(model.predict([[8]])[0]), 2))
Example output
17.0

Handle mixed data types

Use ColumnTransformer when different columns need different transformations. For example, impute or scale numeric values and one-hot encode category values. Put the ColumnTransformer inside the pipeline so its fitted parameters stay within each training fold.
